title: THE WRATH OF OLD VALYRIA // THE HORN DRAGONBINDER
narrative: Clad in full plate of oiled black Valyrian steel etched with red glyphs, Euron stands on the bloody forecastle. Thirty holy men—septs, red priests, and damphairs—are bled over the railings into the sea. The water foams purple and churns with violent undertows. From the fathomless ocean floor, tentacles thicker than castle pillars rise, wrapping around the hulls of the Redwyne war galleys and snapping three-decked carracks like dry matchsticks.

options.text: Steer the kraken host toward the high white beacon of Oldtown.
Sail the conquered Arbor fleet straight to the iron throne.
